name: いいねと返信操作付きのコメント
prompt:
Create one standalone Japanese Instagram-style comment row on a clean white canvas, exactly 390 × 106 px. Use the native Japanese preview for the exact frame, avatar, colors, typography, copy and positions. Use the source crop for the comment-and-reply structure, but use the localized preview wording. No device frame or watermark.

At upper left, place a 36px pale-mint circular avatar with the dark initial `山` at x≈16, y≈10. To its right, place bold dark `山田 はるか` at x≈68, y≈8 and small muted-gray `1日前` aligned toward the right on the same line. Below the name, set the exact comment text `とてもすてきです！見ていて元気が出ます。` in dark Japanese sans serif on two compact lines. Below that, place muted-gray `返信する` at x≈68. At the far right, align a thin gray outline heart beside the comment, with muted-gray count `160` beneath it.

The text is not a hyperlink. Keep the name and comment dark, timestamp/reply/count muted gray, and heart outline gray; do not color text blue. The small blue mark in the original source is a verification icon and is omitted from the Japanese preview, so do not invent a blue text label or badge. Preserve the exact Japanese punctuation and the compact airy spacing of the 390 × 106 preview.
reviewNotes: Exact localized comment and actions; component has no linked text. Candidate leaves excess vertical canvas margin compared with the 390x106 preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
